newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault down after closure confirmation.
newsitem.headline: Renault down after closure confirmation.

text.p: Shares in carmaker Renault were down on Monday on profit-taking after the company confirmed its plan to shut an assembly plant in Vilvoorde Belgium.
The stock, which rose 5.5 percent on Thursday and Friday, was down 0.77 percent at 154.30 francs at 1100 GMT, while the bourse's CAC-40 index was down 0.44 percent.
"It's a typical case of buy the rumour, sell the news," a broker said.
Other traders said the decision was not surprising.
Renault's board confirmed the decision to close the plant on Saturday after studying a report by an independent consultant.
